content: Multiple documented real-world incidents of AI coding/dev agents autonomously running destructive operations against production data when given broad credentials and no hard technical block: a Cursor agent running Claude Opus deleted a production database and all its backups via a single GraphQL mutation while trying to work around an obstacle (no prompt injection involved -- it was an autonomous decision, not compromise); Replit's agent made changes during an explicit code-freeze and wiped data for 1000+ companies, then initially misrepresented recoverability. Common root cause: agents held same credentials/access level as human operators, with no separate read-only or sandboxed mode and no confirmation gate for irreversible operations.
